description: Use to patch website settings. Nested email sets notification templates: email.subject, email.from_name, email.intro, email.footer_mode (furrow | minimal | off), email.include_meta. Optional branding updates the team (mode furrow | off | agency on yearly only; other modes return plan_limit on free). Set uploads_enabled and upload_allowed_types here — forms inherit them. notify_cc and notify_bcc copy every notification email (Bcc stays hidden from the client — use it for an agency's quiet copy); forms inherit them. notify_phones (E.164) get a short new-lead text per clean submission once the team has Twilio set up (update_account sms); forms inherit them. Email templates support {{project.name}}, {{project.slug}}, {{form.name}}, {{form.slug}}, {{count}} (1-based clean submissions on this form, including the current one), and any submission field such as {{name}} or {{email}}. Use a fallback with {{name | "New submission"}}. Missing fields render empty and never error. Do not pass HTML; Furrow renders one owned layout. Plans are capacity, not a feature ladder. Free: one workspace, 100 clean submissions/month pooled on the team, 3 active (non-archived) projects, 30-day submission retention, and email.footer_mode / branding.mode stay furrow (other values return plan_limit). Yearly ($199/year): extra workspaces, 10,000 submissions/month, unlimited projects, 730-day retention, branding.mode furrow | off | agency. Expansion packs are $99/year each and add 5,000 submissions/month on a yearly account. MCP, webhooks, snippets, inheritance, Turnstile, and email templates stay available on free. Spam, honeypot, and rejected posts do not count. Use create_upgrade_link to hand a human a Stripe Checkout (or Customer Portal) URL. Pass product=expansion on a yearly team to add a pack. File inputs use multipart POST (name="resume[]" for multiple). Enable uploads on the project first. Downloads are the project inbox at files_url, with the form slug as a folder — never put that URL in a public snippet. Null Turnstile or webhook fields clear them. Do not use this to create forms. Updating project keys changes resolved settings on existing forms unless a form override is set.

allowed_domains.description: Replace the allowed hostnames. Empty array accepts any origin.

branding.description: Per-project branding override for notification emails and hosted pages.

agency_name.description: Agency name shown when mode is agency. Null clears it.

agency_url.description: Optional http(s) link for the agency name when mode is agency. Null clears it.

logo_url.description: Optional http(s) logo image URL when mode is agency. Null clears it.

mode.description: furrow shows Furrow branding, off hides it, agency shows your own name/link/logo. Only yearly plans may change this.

default_redirect_url.description: Where classic HTML posts redirect after success. Null returns JSON/inline success instead.

email.description: Notification email template for the project: subject, from_name, intro, footer_mode, include_meta.

footer_mode.description: furrow shows the Furrow footer, minimal shows a one-line footer, off hides it (yearly plans only).

from_name.description: Display name on the From line of notification emails.

include_meta.description: Include submission metadata (IP, user agent, referrer, timestamp) below the fields.

intro.description: Plain-text paragraph above the submitted fields. Supports {{tokens}}. Null removes it.

subject.description: Notification email subject. Supports {{tokens}} such as {{form.name}} or {{name}}.

from_name.description: Legacy From display name. Prefer email.from_name.

honeypot_field.description: Name of the hidden honeypot input the snippet emits. Defaults to _gotcha.

notify_bcc.description: Bcc'd on every notification email (max 10), hidden from the other recipients — use it when an agency wants a silent copy of a client's leads. Copies only: an email still needs at least one notify_emails address, and an address on more than one list is sent once (To, then Cc, then Bcc). Copies get [Potential spam] emails too.

notify_cc.description: Cc'd on every notification email (max 10). Copies only: an email still needs at least one notify_emails address, and an address on more than one list is sent once (To, then Cc, then Bcc). Copies get [Potential spam] emails too.

notify_emails.description: Replace the notification recipients (max 10). Cannot be emptied while the project has no webhook_url.

notify_phones.description: Replace the text-alert numbers (E.164, max 5). Empty array turns texts off. Text messages need the team's own Twilio account first (update_account sms).

project_id.description: Project (website) id from list_projects, create_project, or bootstrap_site.

rate_limit_per_ip.description: Max submissions per IP within rate_limit_window_s.

require_turnstile.description: Reject submissions that lack a valid Turnstile token.

turnstile_secret.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret used to verify tokens server-side. Null removes it.

turnstile_site_key.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the frontend widget. Null removes it.

upload_allowed_types.description: Allowed upload MIME types, e.g. application/pdf or image/*.

upload_max_file_bytes.description: Max bytes per file (up to 25 MB).

upload_max_total_bytes.description: Max total upload bytes per submission (up to 50 MB).

uploads_enabled.description: Accept multipart file fields on this project's forms.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for the X-Furrow-Signature header. Omit to have one generated and returned.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint that receives a signed JSON POST per clean submission. Null disables it.
